    override fun onUpdate(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) {

            spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds -= deltaTimeInMilliseconds
            if (spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds <= 0) {

        if (timer1RemainingInMilliseconds > 0) {

    }

    private fun onGameStarted(kubriko: Kubriko) {
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone", source = "EveryManager")
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}", source = "EveryManager")
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (false) {
                                if (Random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            // This Block only works in an Actor type.
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            // This Block only works in an Actor type.
                                        }
                                        score += 2f
                                        title = "Hi"
                                        isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (score > 1f) {
                                            if (title == "") {
                                                if (isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${score.asText()} ${title} ${isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}", source = "EveryManager")
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onKeyPressedDirectionLeft() {
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.

        // This Block only works in an Actor type.

        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone", source = "EveryManager")
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}", source = "EveryManager")
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.

        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (false) {
                                if (Random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            // This Block only works in an Actor type.
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            // This Block only works in an Actor type.
                                        }
                                        score += 2f
                                        title = "Hi"
                                        isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.

                                            if (title == "") {
                                                if (isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${score.asText()} ${title} ${isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}", source = "EveryManager")
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")

    private fun onTimer1Finished(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) {
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone", source = "EveryManager")
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}", source = "EveryManager")
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (false) {
                                if (Random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            // This Block only works in an Actor type.
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            // This Block only works in an Actor type.
                                        }
                                        score += 2f
                                        title = "Hi"
                                        isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (score > 1f) {
                                            if (title == "") {
                                                if (isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${score.asText()} ${title} ${isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}", source = "EveryManager")
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")

                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.
        // This Block only works in an Actor type.

    private val textStyle1 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle2 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle3 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle4 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle5 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle6 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle7 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle8 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle9 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    @Composable
    override fun Composable(windowInsets: WindowInsets) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().windowInsetsPadding(windowInsets).padding(16.dp),
        ) {
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopStart),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle1,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopCenter),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle2,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle3,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterStart),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle4,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle5,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterEnd),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle6,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomStart),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle7,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle8,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomEnd),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle9,
            )
        }
    }

    private fun Float.asText() = if (this % 1f == 0f) toLong().toString() else toString()
}
